scientific_payload.context_block:
[Document 1]
To define the concentrations of inhibin in serum and tissue of patients with hydatidiform mole and assess their value as a clinical marker of the condition.

[Document 2]
Prospective study of new patients with hydatidiform mole, comparison of paired observations, and case-control analysis.

[Document 3]
To study whether nontriploid partial hydatidiform moles truly exist.

[Document 4]
We conducted a reevaluation of pathology and ploidy in 19 putative nontriploid partial hydatidiform moles using standardized histologic diagnostic criteria and repeat flow cytometric testing by the Hedley technique.

[Document 5]
Correlation of serum inhibin concentrations with trophoblastic disease.
